by.quote: c3_0311 "The sleeve in the corner of the second photo." FLAT (explains itself). Akane's "Both of them." has already pointed at the 0310 plant. Two pointers in a row connect the dots for the reader.

items.why: Only the diagnosis touches the photo, and its problem is the double-pointed sleeve clue, not the photo routine reading as Kōhei controlling Akane; the readers praised the photos.

by.quote: c3_0392 kohei: "Back there. You didn't take the picture." CUT (explains itself; check the outline). 0388 already landed "She doesn't take the shot." Pointing at it turns a quiet image into a flagged mystery. ... Cut the untaken-photo exchange (0392–0393) unless the outline calls for it.

Natsuki's camera is aimed at the branch the moment before the light appears under it ... With her lens on the branch one beat before the light shows up under it, a reader can conclude that she saw it too.

items.why: Diagnosis cuts the 0392–0393 camera exchange as over-flagging the beat; continuity calls the 0388 camera beat an extra signal (its fix re-aims rather than cuts). All three readers praised the untaken shot.

by.quote: c3_0080 "It lands somewhere I wasn't guarding." FLAT (vouches; low priority). It tells us 0079 hit. The line is strong enough on its own, and a physical beat would do more.

items.why: Diagnosis names the line as telling the reader the hit landed (also in S2/S4); readers 1 and 3 praised it.

by.quote: iPad: in the window CGs, the text box and Kōhei's face window hide the rabbit, so the narration describes things the player can't see ... Nanoha's folded arms are also under the box.

items.why: Build flags the text box covering the bottom of the same three CGs on iPad, but names the rabbit and her arms, not her face (tested at 1180×820, not his 1080×810).
No check flagged c3_0336 'Trash bags.' as leaning on the Ch1–2 running bit; the diagnosis praised the trash-bags lines and the readers read Ch1–2 straight before it.
Nothing flagged the bridge callback at c3_0343–c3_0345 as needing Ch2 fresh in mind.

by.quote: Kōhei laughing is becoming Natsuki's signature: "I laugh before I can decide not to" here, plus the chair at the restaurant. It's a clear signal, maybe a little too consistently placed.

Bit of a pattern: Kōhei "laughs before he can decide not to" in almost every Natsuki scene now (restaurant twice, bridge-adjacent, here twice). The device is working but it's getting repetitive as a narration beat.

items.why: Two readers point at c3_0351 but call the laugh beat repetitive or mechanical, not too edgy in tone; the diagnosis kept it.

by.quote: c3_0359 and c3_0365: "She lifts the camera" and "pulled the camera back against her chest with both hands". The sprite holds the camera at her waist with one hand.

items.why: Build cites c3_0359 only for a sprite-pose mismatch; nobody said 'before I can get a hand up' was unclear.

by.quote: "Just stopping for a rest." / "Looks like rain tomorrow." Intriguing, but completely opaque. Readers who don't know the superstition about stumbling on shrine steps get nothing, and Kōhei "never once asked."

items.why: Reader1 finds the step ritual opaque, a different problem from 'it' (c3_0402) reading as the rain; readers 2 and 3 called it well judged, and the diagnosis only tags 0400's tone.
Onmodel lists both Nanoha's and Akane's cream cardigans as on model; reader2 mentions Nanoha's 'cream sweater' only while saying she's hard to recognize, never that she looks like Akane.
Onmodel, build and all three readers confirmed the cg_lunch seating matches c3_0413; nobody questioned Grandpa's place.

by.quote: Genji: "And you're the young lady with the camera. Take as many as you like. The tree doesn't mind." A stock wise grandpa (though "The tree doesn't mind" may be a deliberate wink).
